name: CAP-Y2SAVEUNDO2
question: Y2: CAP-Y2SAVEUNDO read again, the same steps: Save after an Undo back to the page as it loaded, by the Undo button and by Cmd+Z, after a blank section alone, a Text added, a Text written in.
answer: Save is on while the page differs from how it loaded and off once it is the same again, by the Undo button and by Cmd+Z alike. A blank section alone: on; one Undo takes the section away and Save goes off; Redo brings both back. A Text added: one Undo takes the Text, Save stays on (the blank section is left); the next takes the section, Save off. A Text written in (ab), or Write pressed and nothing typed: the same, Save off only at the last step, when the section is gone. So CAP-Y2KEYS2's 'Undo button, just added' read Save on because its blank section was still there, not by a rule of its own. Read twice: CAP-Y2SAVEUNDO and CAP-Y2SAVEUNDO2 agree on every read's save, sections and controls.
ours: The same rule: ours compares the page with the saved one (app/src/editor.js, savedJson). The replay made no change for the oracle's blank Add Section; it now adds a blank section at the page's end, an undo step of its own.
pressed: Undo and Redo by name (pressNamed). Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z as keys. The section by Add Section, Add Blank (blank). Nothing saved: Exit Without Saving.
